systems.name: Ubuntu Touch
systems.notes: Official port (miatoll). Needs the stock Android 10 firmware underneath.

systems.name: postmarketOS
systems.notes: Unsupported variant: needs a U-Boot match patch and upstream tqftpserv. No charger driver (slow charging). Only the macro camera works, with an excalibur device tree and a qcom-camss fix (camera/). Call audio untested.
